narration: One stripe. Two animals. Turns, not pulling.
caption: एक पट्टी। दो जानवर। खींचातानी नहीं, बारी-बारी।
image_brief: The band of light on the ceiling with a crocodile shadow at one end and a rabbit shadow at the other end.

narration: The crocodile swims over his sister's cot. She pulls up her blanket.
caption: मगरमच्छ बहन की खाट के ऊपर तैरता है। वह कंबल ऊपर खींच लेती है।
image_brief: The sister on her back in her cot with the crocodile shadow moving across the ceiling directly above her face.

narration: The rabbit hops along its back. Nobody argues.
caption: खरगोश उसकी पीठ पर उछलता है। कोई झगड़ा नहीं।
image_brief: The rabbit shadow hopping along the crocodile's ceiling back, both shapes held inside the same lit band.

narration: Ishaan counts the ceiling boards it covers. Six.
caption: इशान गिनता है कि यह छत के कितने तख़्ते ढकता है। छह।
image_brief: Ishaan pointing up and counting ceiling boards, six of them crossed by the shadow, his sister following his finger.

narration: Bigger than the crocodile he planned for four nights.
caption: उस मगरमच्छ से भी बड़ा, जो वह चार रातों से सोच रहा था।
image_brief: Ishaan's four pencil drawings lying forgotten on his cot while the real ceiling shadow stretches overhead.

narration: Nobody is holding the torch at all. The books do.
caption: टॉर्च को कोई पकड़े हुए नहीं है। किताबें पकड़े हैं।
image_brief: The unattended torch upright on the four books, both children's hands resting loose on the floorboards beside it.

narration: Grandmother looks in and says nothing. The door stays open a hand's width.
caption: दादी झाँककर देखती हैं और कुछ नहीं कहतीं। दरवाज़ा एक हाथ भर खुला रहता है।
image_brief: The grandmother half in the doorway with a small smile, the lit ceiling shadow visible past her shoulder.

narration: His sister's eyes close under the crocodile.
caption: बहन की आँखें मगरमच्छ के नीचे मुँद जाती हैं।
image_brief: The sister asleep with her cheek on the pillow, the crocodile shadow spread wide on the ceiling above her.

narration: She asks for one more snap. Ishaan gives her three.
caption: वह एक और चटक माँगती है। इशान उसे तीन देता है।
image_brief: Ishaan's hands snapping the jaw shape above the torch, the ceiling crocodile's mouth opening and closing.

narration: Then the light goes thin and orange. The battery is finishing.
caption: फिर रोशनी पतली और नारंगी हो जाती है। बैटरी ख़त्म हो रही है।
image_brief: The torch beam dimmed to a weak orange, the ceiling crocodile faint and blurred at its edges.

narration: The ceiling goes dark. Ishaan knows exactly where it sleeps.
caption: छत अँधेरी हो जाती है। इशान को पता है वह कहाँ सोया है।
image_brief: The dark bedroom with only a line of hallway light, both cots dim, the ceiling plain and quiet above them.

narration: The books stay on the stool for tomorrow.
caption: किताबें कल के लिए स्टूल पर ही रहती हैं।
image_brief: The stack of four books on the stool with the switched-off torch balanced on top, lit only by hallway light.

narration: Ishaan lies back and wants this minute to stay.
caption: इशान लेट जाता है और चाहता है कि यह पल ठहर जाए।
image_brief: Ishaan on his back with his hands behind his head, smiling up at the dark ceiling, his sister asleep nearby.

narration: His sister whispers something into the dark. Ishaan answers it exactly.
caption: बहन अँधेरे में धीरे से कुछ कहती है। इशान ठीक वही जवाब देता है।
image_brief: Two dark cots with the children's faces just visible, the door ajar behind them letting in a thin line of light.

caption: एक चटक, दो चटक, मगरमच्छ!
image_brief: Ishaan's hand resting on his blanket with two fingers lightly touching, the dark ceiling above, a thin line of hallway light on the wall.
